title: Bind learning programs
statement: Fix a dimension, an access mode, and input and output types, and let a continuation assign an output-type program to each input value. Binding the continuation to a program replaces its returned value with the corresponding continuation program, propagates through random-bit draws, example draws, input batches, queries, and local-work charges, and preserves those operations. For a program that computes an output from a random-example matrix with a specified work charge, binding draws the same matrix, charges that work, and then runs the continuation on the computed output.
hypotheses_covered: input and output types are specified
a continuation from input values to programs is given
